description: This file defines the ListStateClient class and ListStateIterator class for managing state in Spark Structured Streaming, including methods for checking existence, retrieving, appending, putting, and clearing list state, as well as iterating over state data.

classes.name: ListStateClient
classes.description: Client class for managing list state in Spark Structured Streaming, providing methods to check existence, retrieve, append, put, and clear list state data.

classes.name: ListStateIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing list state data managed by ListStateClient, supporting iteration over state rows.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes ListStateClient with a stateful processor API client and schema.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a given state name exists in the state store.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the next row from the list state for a given iterator ID.

methods.name: append_value
methods.description: Appends a single value to the list state.

methods.name: append_list
methods.description: Appends multiple values to the list state.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Replaces the list state with a new list of values.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the list state for a given state name.
